glass_sam: Previous notes assumed cupboard_k1 based on day 7, but day 8 feedback at 19:34 and 21:53 showed it at dining_table_d1 and nightstand_b1 respectively. The location is highly variable and does not stay in the kitchen cupboard. Do not default to cupboard_k1. Check dining_table_d1 for evening queries (around 19:00) and nightstand_b1 for late night queries (after 21:00). The item moves between the dining area and the bedroom.

charger_sam: Previous notes assumed desk_b1 based on day 7, but day 8 feedback at 21:53 showed it at nightstand_b1. The location alternates between desk_b1 and nightstand_b1 in the late evening. Do not strictly assume desk_b1 for all late-night queries. Check nightstand_b1 for queries after 21:00, as it appears to move there later in the night, contradicting the day 7 pattern.

mug_sam: Previous notes assumed coffee_table_l1 for late evening based on day 7. No new errors today, so this pattern remains relevant. Check coffee_table_l1 for queries between 19:00 and 23:00. Do not assume it moves to the bedroom desk.

General Observation: Day 8 evidence shows that item locations are less static than day 7 suggested. Glass_sam moves between dining and bedroom; charger_sam moves from desk to nightstand late at night. Prioritize recent feedback over older patterns. For glass_sam, check dining_table_d1 in early evening and nightstand_b1 late at night. For charger_sam, check nightstand_b1 after 21:00.
